split_rule: Every evaluation case is held out. The activation moments and the averaged Hessian are estimated on generic pretraining text from NeelNanda/pile-10k, the same corpus the published J-lens was fitted on (25 documents, t_max 128, skip_first 4), so the first- and second-order operators are estimated on the same distribution and no evaluation prompt informs the fit. The moments use every (document, position) pair; the averaged Hessian is capped at hessian_pairs by a seeded subsample because it costs one forward-over-forward pass per (coordinate, pair).
